answer_1.quote: We further propose Visual News Captioner, a model that generates captions by attending to both individual word tokens and named entities in an input news article text, and localized visual features.

answer_2.quote: Following previous literature, we evaluate model performance on two categories of metrics. To measure the overall similarity between generated captions and ground truth, we report BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE and CIDEr scores. ... On the other hand, we compute the precision and recall scores for named entities to evaluate the model ability to predict named entities.
